caption_en:
Customer pays half in dollars, half in lira? No calculator needed.

In LiraTek, prices, payments, change and drawers are all in USD and LBP. Split a payment across both, and run currency exchange from the same system.

(Screens from our demo shop.)

Want to see it in your shop? Message us on WhatsApp: +961 81 077 357 (link in bio).
